description: This file defines the ColumnLikeGridlinesRenderer class, which renders gridlines for column or line charts in a PDF charting library. It includes methods for drawing gridlines based on axis scales and formatting.

classes.name: ColumnLikeGridlinesRenderer
classes.description: Renderer for gridlines in column or line charts, drawing lines on the plot area based on axis scales and gridline formats.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws gridlines on the plot area for both X and Y axes, using minor and major gridline formats if available.

search-terms: X and Y axis grid rendering
